page_title: Turn your long video into viral clips with AI magic

sources.entry: Vizard - identifies highlights to create short social clips. #free

summary.name: Vizard
summary.one_liner: Vizard is an AI tool that turns long-form videos into short, social-ready clips for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
use_cases: Turn long webinars into a month of social posts
Clip podcasts and interviews into short videos
Create TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts from long videos
Repurpose coaching or course videos for social media
Resize videos to vertical format for social platforms
summary.what_it_does: Vizard transcribes an uploaded video, identifies engaging moments, and cuts them into clips automatically. It centers key subjects in vertical format and can resize clips for different social platforms with one click. The built-in editor lets users trim by deleting transcript text, adjust captions on a timeline, and translate captions into over 100 languages. Users can apply templates, share clips as links, or publish directly from the tool.
notable: Automatically detects highlights and crops to vertical format with subjects centered
Transcript-based editing: trim video by deleting text
Team workspace for sharing previews with clients
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it as free but the page itself does not confirm plan limits
Testimonial performance claims (views, savings) are self-reported and not verified
